rows.note: Use this for acoustic features or materials concerned with blocking or controlling sound, such as an acoustic wall or panel.

example.english: This acoustic wall is very effective; you can hardly hear the traffic outside.
example.traditional: 呢幅隔音牆好有效，街外嘅車聲幾乎聽唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 gaak3 jam1 coeng4 hou2 jau5 haau6 gaai1 ngoi6 ge3 ce1 seng1 gei1 fu4 teng1 m4 dou3

rows.note: Use this for an instrument or its sound when it is produced naturally without electrical amplification.

example.english: I like hearing this band perform with an acoustic guitar.
example.traditional: 我鍾意聽呢隊樂隊用原聲結他演出。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 teng1 nei1 deoi2 ngok6 deoi2 jung6 jyun4 sing1 git6 taa1 jin2 ceot1

rows.note: Use this for a device or system operated by sound, such as a voice- or sound-controlled light.

example.english: This light uses acoustic control; say a word and it comes on.
example.traditional: 呢盞燈係聲控嘅，叫一聲就會着。
example.jyutping: ni1 zaan2 dang1 hai6 sing1 hung3 ge3 giu3 jat1 sing1 zau6 wui5 zoek6
